name: God of Hookah
qaNote: Reference inspected. Preserve wrapped headwear, dark tailored outfit, bronze hookah and hose; replace tiny boot crown emblem with fist. Cyan digital-device highlights require masking if visible; pocket device early, not recoloring. Review smoke keying, relay clarity and title.

result.prompt:
Create an EPIC 8-second illustrated fighting-game super finisher, portrait 9:16. Bold hand-inked outlines, rich cel shading, dynamic comic-book perspective, exaggerated scale and explosive acceleration. Reference image defines the exact character identity, face, costume, colors and props, NOT the background or initial camera crop. Preserve the illustrated character; no live-action or 3D makeover. Make a complete miniature action scene with a surprising payoff and a charismatic ending, not an idle animation with particles.
CAMERA AND COMPOSITING: cinematic camera motion is encouraged: dramatic pullbacks to reveal impossible scale, depth travel and deliberate close-ups. Establish the complete character early and return to a clear hero composition. Keep face and anatomy correct; intentional close-up crops are fine, accidental chopped limbs in a wide shot are not. The unoccupied backing remains perfectly flat pure cyan #00FFFF in EVERY shot, including close-ups. No scenery, floor plane, opaque rectangular manga panel, background gradient, vignette or full-frame whiteout. Use foreground objects and perspective to communicate distance. Large impact stars and disconnected tapered speed strokes terminate naturally on cyan instead of connecting to image borders. Warm effect colors with ink edges; no cyan/turquoise glow that will disappear under chroma key. No crowns.
TEXT: one exact move title, thick uppercase comic lettering, warm white-to-gold fill, chunky black outline and dark offset extrusion, angled forceful slam with brief overshoot and settle. Stable readable spelling, intelligently placed away from the face, no additional captions or words. A title arrival is an impact beat of its own.
SOUND: strong synchronized anticipation, accelerating whooshes, exaggerated action hits, one dominant payoff, and a short settling tail. No music, speech or narration.

God of Hookah — Pass the Hose.
IDENTITY: exact adult brown-skinned man with black mustache and goatee, dark wrapped headwear with rust-red/gold patterned bands, dark-brown high-collared gold-button jacket, charcoal trousers, belt and tall brown boots. Preserve the ornate bronze hookah and black hose. Replace the tiny crown emblem on the boot with a small gold FIST. Keep his small black digital device authentic but pocket it at the beginning so the main action centers on hookah and hose.
0–1.2s: establish full body. He calmly pockets the little device, lifts the bronze hookah and taps its bowl once. One burning orange ember rises; his free hand whips the hose into a broad overhead loop.
1.2–3.2s: camera pulls dramatically backward and upward. The hose's motion draws THREE immense separate serpentine smoke creatures, made of thick opaque ivory and warm-gray comic smoke with bronze ink edges. They coil at different depths twenty feet apart, framing his tiny but complete figure. These are mythic smoke effects, no scenery, fog layer, blue glow or background cloud. Cyan remains between their loops and around their outer silhouettes.
3.2–4.8s: the first creature catches the single orange ember, its outlined belly lights amber, and it blasts the ember into the second creature; the second passes it to the third. Camera races along the relay in one accelerating curve. Each handoff adds scale and force; the THIRD exhales a colossal orange fire-ring that slams outward through all three coils with a thunderous dominant BOOM and a sharp impact hold. Show three distinct sequential passes, not random particle spray. Finite warm-white/orange impact stars with clean cyan margins, no fullscreen flash.
4.8–6s: snap-zoom back toward his composed face. With a small wrist flick he collapses all three enormous smoke creatures neatly into the bronze bowl, as exact title PASS THE HOSE slams below his face in two powerful comic lines.
6–8s: whole-character hero hold, hose offered forward. One stubborn tiny smoke serpent peeks out of the bowl; he gives it a stern sideways look, and it ducks back inside with a small embarrassed puff. Face, costume and title stay stable. SFX: brass bowl tap, immense swirling hose whoosh, three accelerating ember handoffs, roaring final fire-ring BOOM, vacuum-like smoke recoil, tiny final puff. No speech, music or chanting.
